title: Pricing — Inovexa ERP | Plans in US dollars, free trial
description: Starter, Business and Enterprise plans, priced in US dollars. 3-day free trial with no bank card, then online card payment: your access opens automatically.

c: Try it free for 3 days, with no bank card. Then you choose your plan and pay online by bank card: your access opens by itself. Your data is kept in every case.

title: Three plans, sized to your team

labels.vatNote: Prices in US dollars, excluding tax; VAT at {rate}% is added. During the free trial, every module is open.

lead: One price per company, not per module. Each plan opens the modules of your sector that it includes.

labels.note: A module included in the plan is open if it is part of your business sector. The dashboard, profile and settings are always open.

items.title: Create your account
items.text: Enter your company and your sector. The trial starts straight away, with no bank card.

items.title: Use the ERP for 3 days
items.text: Every module is open: you choose your sector and your modules yourself. A countdown shows the time left.

items.title: Choose your plan and pay by card
items.text: You pay online whenever you like. During the trial, the paid period only starts when the trial ends: no free day is lost.

items.title: Your access opens by itself
items.text: As soon as the payment is confirmed, your subscription is active and your receipt is available: nobody has anything to approve. Without payment, access is suspended at the end of the trial and your data is kept.

title: Payment methods

c: Visa and Mastercard, Tunisian bank cards and the e-Dinar card. Your card number is entered on the payment provider’s page: it never goes through Inovexa ERP.

lead: You pay online, by bank card, on our payment provider’s secure page. As soon as the payment is confirmed, your access is open and your receipt is available: you wait for no one.

items.q: Do I need a bank card to try it?
items.a: No. You create your account with your email address and the trial starts immediately.

items.q: What happens at the end of the trial?
items.a: Without payment, access to the ERP is suspended. Your data is kept and access returns as soon as you pay for your plan online.

items.q: Can I pay before the trial ends?
items.a: Yes. The paid period starts when the trial ends: you do not lose a single free day.
Yes. Prices are shown in US dollars, excluding tax; the amount including tax is shown before you pay, and the exact amount charged appears on the payment page.
No. There is no automatic charge: we remind you before the due date and you renew online when you decide.

items.q: What is the difference between monthly and yearly?
items.a: A yearly subscription costs less than twelve monthly payments: the saving is shown on each plan.
Yes. You choose your plan with each payment: you can move up or down at renewal.

items.q: Do I get proof of payment?
items.a: Yes. A numbered receipt is available in your workspace as soon as the payment is confirmed; the invoice is sent to you by the publisher.
Yes: set-up, data migration and team training, on quote. Write to us.
Yes, at any time from the Subscription page of your workspace.

title: A question about pricing?
lead: Write to us: we will help you choose the plan that fits your team.
